info.description: The Education Enrollment Management API facilitates the process of enrolling students into various educational programs. By leveraging this endpoint, institutions can efficiently manage enrollment requests, ensuring that students gain access to the courses they desire. This API primarily serves educational institutions and administrative staff who are responsible for student enrollment. Use cases include batch enrollment for new academic sessions or individual student enrollment for specific courses. It streamlines the registration process, enhancing the overall educational experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new enrollment record in the system, capturing all necessary details for the enrollment process.
